name: Net
description: A weighted net of heavy cord, thrown to tangle.
body:
## What it is

A creature of Large size or smaller that it hits is restrained until freed. It holds nothing that is formless or Huge and larger. An action and a DC 10 Strength check frees the creature or one within reach; so does dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10), which ruins it. An action, bonus action or reaction spent attacking with a net makes one attack only, however many you could make.
